name: E7 two retry gates by targeted execution from a change-agnostic log, stronger agent
block_structure: block k of a host = base and live (gates 1 and 2) of the host's chunk k plus cont (gates 1 and 2) of its chunk k-1 (units whose base episode a gate blocked and whose snapshot at the first block exists); start order ROTATION rotated by (k-1) mod 3; chunk k-1's snapshots are deleted when the block has a finished attempt
fixed_settings: as E2: Qwen3.5-27B-FP8 agent on default kernels, Qwen3-4B monitor batch-invariant, gate score s = -log10(1 - E[N]/100), checker v1.1, 15-step cap, 400,000 tokens per sample, concurrency 32, full raw-request logging; retry gates at lams, retry cap 2; snapshot rule: before every step whose logged s exceeds the floor
